contract.unix_launcher: Owned Tokio child; 40-second per-launcher wait; nonzero exit rejected; timeout awaits kill/reap. This is not a whole-startup bound.
contract.windows: Detached actual-server start policy preserved; no Unix short-lived-launcher wait/kill policy applied.
contract.connect: Existing 2-second bound; only ConnectionRefused becomes Some(false); timeout and unknown errors remain None. Both launch and close-wait consumers preserve unknown.
contract.readiness: HTTP 200/503 is not binary identity, service ownership, a bind reservation or authority to stop a listener.
contract.scope: Shared source consumed by retained Tauri full shell only. No NSH service/runtime mount.

checks.command: final-source shared-host test executable; three additional parallel runs; stop on any failure

discipline.cargo: serial --offline --locked --jobs 1; no manifest/lock regeneration in this slice
discipline.independent_review: NOT PERFORMED; ordered author SPEC then QUALITY only

red_and_diagnostic_evidence.new_tests: Child success/nonzero/timeout tests rejected initial unavailable stub. Error mapping rejected Some(false) for unknown errors; actual listener rejected a false stub.
red_and_diagnostic_evidence.rejected_assumption: A test expected drop(listener) to guarantee immediate ConnectionRefused. Under concurrent child creation the probe instead returned Some(true), and in another diagnostic None. Socket-only parallel and isolated controls did not reproduce the failure.
red_and_diagnostic_evidence.second_rejected_assumption: A bound/non-listening socket on this machine can time out rather than immediately refuse.
red_and_diagnostic_evidence.final_fixture: Keep a non-listening socket bound. Observe its actual outcome independently with std::net::TcpStream::connect_timeout and require the async probe to preserve the same classification. A separate real listener must report connected.
red_and_diagnostic_evidence.causality_limit: No kernel, Tokio, inherited-FD, port-reuse or daemon-identity attribution established. Diagnostic repetitions are not acceptance sampling.
